title: The Tree by the Water
old_p1: Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah a picture to share with everybody. 'Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord,' the words said.
'He shall be as a tree planted by the waters.' Jeremiah said it out loud, so that everyone could hear.
That tree spreads out her roots beside the river. Deep down where nobody can see, she is drinking all day long.
old_p2: So the tree is not worried when the hot days come. Her leaves stay green, and she goes right on giving fruit.
Trusting Heavenly Father is just like that. Even on your hardest day, something quiet inside you keeps drinking. Your roots are in a river that never dries up.
p1: Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah a picture to share with everyone. “Happy is the person who trusts in the Lord,” the words said.
“That person is like a tree planted beside a river.” Jeremiah said it out loud so everyone could hear.
A tree by a river sends its roots deep down to the water. Down where nobody can see, it is drinking all day long.
p2: So the tree is not scared when the hot, dry days come. Its leaves stay green, and it keeps growing fruit.
Trusting Heavenly Father is like that. When you pray and listen to Him, your roots are drinking from a river that never dries up. Even on your hardest day, something quiet inside you stays green.
